components.title: Static analysis constraints on agent tool configurations
components.teaches: Students will identify common static analyser warnings and strict schema violations that arise when registering MCP server endpoints. They will review rule sets for configuration linters, strict typing of input parameters, and required metadata tags.

components.title: Configuring custom MCP tool manifests and execution environments
components.teaches: Students will write and configure MCP server manifest files to expose custom tools (such as git, linters, or test runners) directly inside an agent workspace. They will configure environment variables, working directory permissions, and execution sandboxes to ensure deterministic agent actions.

components.title: Validating workspace tool configurations against test suites
components.teaches: Students will walk through setting up and running public integration test suites and static analysis tools against an MCP-integrated agent workspace. They will remediate schema mismatches and failing integration tests until the agent configuration passes cleanly without warnings.

components.title: Diagnosing runtime tool configuration failures in agent workflows
components.teaches: Students will examine real-world case studies where subtle tool configuration errors—such as malformed error responses or improper argument defaults—caused an agent to enter infinite loops or crash. They will identify the root cause in the tool manifest and describe how robust configuration prevents runtime divergence.
